script_text: Aries, your fiery element collides with a rare cosmic crosswire that rewrites your entire week. Early week Monday through Wednesday, Mars your ruling planet squares Saturn in your 10th House career zone, making Tuesday the worst day as boss pressure mounts and a raise stalls. By midweek the turning point hits Wednesday when Venus sextiles Jupiter from your 5th House of love, unlocking romantic surprise. Late week Thursday to Sunday, Sun trines Pluto in your 2nd House of money, Friday sparks a freelance cheque and weekend invites passion with a new crush. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House blessing love. Sunday is your worst day as Mercury retrograde shadows your 7th House partnerships causing arguments. Negotiate career terms Tuesday before the square peaks. Follow for daily updates.
